factual_claims.claim: This recovery was driven by effective optimization of the travel program, which improved the load factor to 98.9% in the fourth quarter and reduced the share of last-minute trips that typically negatively impact financial results.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: By assessing the market situation and customer preferences, we have adjusted our offering accordingly during the year and thus managed to work more efficiently. This has contributed to a higher load factor (a measure of seat capacity utilization) of 98.9% in the fourth quarter compared to 96.7% in 2023. In addition, the share of last-minute trips in sales... has also decreased significantly

factual_claims.claim: The financial strain led to covenant breaches with lenders, although waivers were subsequently obtained.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: As at 31 December 2024, the Group did not comply with all financial and non-financial covenants, under the financing agreements of the Group companies with banks and other credit providers. The waivers were received from “Pagalbos verslui fondas” for ordinary bonds as of 31 December 2024 and from Luminor Bank AS long-term for credit line as of 18 March 2025.

factual_claims.claim: To address liquidity and strategic needs, the Group secured additional financing, including a EUR 2.5 million credit line and a EUR 1 million loan in early 2025.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: 24/01/2025 Novaturas Group is granted a EUR 2.5 mln. credit line. 27/03/2025 Novaturas Group has entered into an agreement to receive a loan of up to EUR 1 million.

factual_claims.claim: Furthermore, the Group entered into a transaction with strategic investor Neset Kockar, who acquired 23.2% of the company’s shares in April 2025, with an additional 9.99% expected to be acquired later.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: 30/04/2025 Novaturas Group signs agreement to sell 23.2% shares to Turkish investor Neset Kockar. The second and final stage of the planned transaction is expected to be completed by autumn. Upon completion of this stage, Neset Kockar will hold 33.19% of the company’s shares.

factual_claims.claim: The arrival of the new investor is expected to provide synergies and support the Group’s return to profitability, with management forecasting EBITDA between EUR 2 million and EUR 3.3 million for 2025.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Based on the current forecast, the Group expects to achieve earnings before interest, tax, amortization and depreciation (EBITDA) in the range of EUR 2 million to EUR 3.3 million in 2025.
